name_en: Koi no Karaage — deep-fried farmed carp from Lake Kasumigaura
summary_ja: 霞ヶ浦周辺で盛んな養殖ゴイを片栗粉で揚げた料理。骨まで食べられるため子どもにも人気で学校給食の定番。にぎわう養殖業を背景に、鯉こくや甘露煮と並ぶコイ料理の一つとして親しまれる。
summary_en: Farmed carp from around Lake Kasumigaura is dusted with potato starch and deep-fried until the bones soften enough to eat — a school-lunch favorite that sits alongside carp soup and simmered carp as a product of the area's long carp-farming trade.
source_title: 鯉の唐揚げ 茨城県
